_comment: RW-11: ruff ratchet baseline. Snapshot of ruff violations in voice_typer/server/ at the time the ratchet was introduced. CI fails if total_count grows OR any individual rule count grows above the value recorded here. This file MUST only shrink over time — never edit it to add violations. To regenerate after fixing violations, run: ruff check voice_typer/server/ --output-format=json | python scripts/ruff_ratchet_check.py --regenerate
